subject: Nimbus: SDK versioning & v1 deprecation — compatibility plan request
messages:
From: Rachel Park <rachel.park@nimbus-analytics.com>
To: sergio_alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Owen Li <owen.li@nimbus-analytics.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Mar 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Request: SDK compatibility & v1 deprecation timeline

Hi Sergio —

Quick background: Nimbus runs our inference orchestration layer on top of Redwood for several Fortune 200 customers. We shipped a Nimbus SDK adapter that relied heavily on Redwood SDK v1 streaming semantics and two internal helper hooks ("_open_stream" and "_finalize_chunk"). With announcement of Redwood SDK v2 and the planned v1 deprecation, our customers are asking for an explicit compatibility/lift path.

Two asks from our engineering team:
- A short-term compatibility shim or backward-compatible release (v2-compatible shim) that preserves the two helper hook behaviors for at least 6 months.
- A clear deprecation timeline and migration guide (sample code) showing how v1 streaming maps to v2's chunked event model.

We attached a short matrix of affected endpoints and a one-page summary of desired API changes. Can your SDK/product teams weigh in on feasibility and target dates? We have a partner steering call next Thu and would like an agreed mutual action plan (MAP).

Thanks — Rachel
Rachel Park
Head of Integrations, Nimbus Analytics

Attachments: requested-api-changes-summary.pdf, nimbus-v2-compat-matrix.xlsx

From: sergio_alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Park <rachel.park@nimbus-analytics.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Mar 2026 11:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SDK compatibility & v1 deprecation timeline

Hi Rachel — thanks for the clear summary and the matrix, that helped. Looping in Vivek (product) and Dev (engineering) to propose options.

High level response: we want to avoid breaking partner integrations and prefer a measured deprecation with a compatibility layer where feasible. Proposed options below — team, please respond with technical feasibility and estimated ETA: 

1) Fast shim: ship a v2.0.1 compatibility package that exposes the v1 hooks mapped onto v2 internals. Goal: hotfix within 3 weeks, supported for 6 months.
2) Migration docs + sample adapters: produce migration guide + code examples and a Nimbus-specific sample adapter in the repo. ETA: 2–4 weeks.
3) Canary program: include Nimbus in a canary cohort for v2 rollout and monitor regressions for a month before making final deprecation decision.

Rachel — do any of those work as immediate options? If yes, we can put dates in a MAP and confirm on the steering call.

— Sergio

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: sergio_alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>, Rachel Park <rachel.park@nimbus-analytics.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 13 Mar 2026 08:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SDK compatibility & v1 deprecation timeline

Rachel / Sergio —

Technical notes from product:
- The core breaking change between v1 -> v2 is the streaming event envelope and the removal of two internal-only hooks. Functionality exists in v2 but surfaced differently (event_type tags + per-chunk metadata).
- We can implement a compatibility shim that translates v2 envelopes to the v1 hook callbacks. However, it requires changes in the SDK runtime (language SDKs) and an additional thin adapter in the server runtime.

Estimated work:
- SDK runtime shim (JS + Python): 2 devs × 2 weeks.
- Server-side thin adapter for streaming behavior: 1 dev × 1 week.
- QA + partner validation (canary): 1 week.

Tentative ETA for a v2.0.1 compatibility release: 2026-04-01 (assuming approvals). We'd support it for 6 months with clear logs of compatibility knobs.

Ask: Laura — can legal sign off on a temporary compatibility commitment (6 months guarantee) and the wording for public deprecation notices?

From: Rachel Park <rachel.park@nimbus-analytics.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, sergio_alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Owen Li <owen.li@nimbus-analytics.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Mar 2026 12:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SDK compatibility & v1 deprecation timeline

Thanks Vivek — that ETA looks reasonable. A few clarifications from Nimbus: 
- The shim must preserve error semantics for client-side retry logic (400 vs 500 classification), otherwise our orchestrator loses correct backoff behavior.
- We need a flag in the SDK so Nimbus can opt-in at install time (e.g., Redwood.enable_compat=true) to avoid touching customers that already migrated.
- For the canary, we can provide a staging cluster and a representative customer workload; we'd like to run the canary starting 2026-04-05.

We'll update our MAP doc with those asks and send to you by Mon. Appreciate the quick alignment.

— Rachel

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: sergio_alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Rachel Park <rachel.park@nimbus-analytics.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Mar 2026 09:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SDK compatibility & v1 deprecation timeline

Rachel / team —

Legal confirms we can commit to a six-month compatibility support window for the v2.0.1 shim, provided Nimbus agrees to the attached acceptance criteria and a limited SLA for canary testing (no financial penalties; operational support only). I'll attach the acceptance checklist to the MAP.

Action items for Redwood (summary):
- Ship v2.0.1 compatibility shim (target 2026-04-01).
- Provide opt-in flag in SDKs and explicit migration guide + code samples (target 2026-03-26).
- Run partner canary with Nimbus starting 2026-04-05.

Laura Bennett
Sr. Counsel, Redwood Inference

From: sergio_alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Park <rachel.park@nimbus-analytics.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Mar 2026 14:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SDK compatibility & v1 deprecation timeline

Thanks all — this is great progress. Rachel, if Nimbus can sign the MAP with the acceptance checklist and provide the staging cluster details by Wed 2026-03-18, we'll lock the dates above and open the GH issue for the compatibility release. I'll also add a short note to the partner steering agenda.

Next steps for Nimbus: sign MAP + provide canary workload (due 2026-03-18)
Action owners for Redwood: Vivek (product) & Dev (eng) — start implementation; Laura (legal) — finalize wording.

Closing note: we want to be careful to avoid broad public messaging that implies v1 will remain indefinitely. The compatibility shim is a transitional measure with an explicit sunset — we'll include clear deprecation dates in the MAP once Nimbus signs off.

— Sergio
